items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: His name was Skeets, Skeets something. But I remember a tune... This guy used to stop the whole thing with a tune called 'No, No, Nora.'

ctx.x: greatest banjo players in the world. His name was Skeets, Skeets something. But I remember a tune... This guy used to stop the whole thing with a tune called 'No, No, Nora.' Whenever he played that, he'd beat half the... In them times, they played encores, and they would play the same tune if you had to take a curtain call or whatever you call it when you get the applause.
This was in Toots Johnson's band.
